name: collect: Mooncake metrics
command:
kubectl exec -n liangjiahao prefill-engine-deployment-75fd46886-pd67q -c prefill-engine -- python3 -c $'import time
from urllib.request import urlopen
url="http://mooncake-master-service:9003/metrics"
deadline=time.monotonic()+60
last=None
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
 try:
  with urlopen(url,timeout=5) as response:
   if response.status==200:
    print(response.read().decode(),end="")
    raise SystemExit(0)
   last=RuntimeError(f"HTTP {response.status}")
 except Exception as exc:
  last=exc
 time.sleep(0.5)
raise SystemExit(f"timeout waiting for Mooncake metrics: {last}")'
